The main features and goals of the EcoFlex app include:

- Live energy prediction charts with confidence shading.
- Tiered push/in-app notifications with fallback.
- Theme switching, error handling, cross-device support.
- Weekly Energy Challenges.
- Badge Collection Mechanism.
- Streak Tracker.
- Scoreboard API Integration.
- Challenge Fairness Algorithm.
- Smart device integration & automation options.
- User preference learning for personalized tips.
- Real-time WebSocket updates & analytics dashboard.

The goals of the EcoFlex app are to turn energy awareness into a habit-forming experience through meaningful interaction, boost user engagement with EcoFlex Home, leverage gamification to foster sustainable behaviors, and align the launch with Q4 Beta release timeline.
EcoFlex: a predictive platform to optimize energy usage, reduce peak demand, and empower sustainable decision-making through intelligent insights.
